description: Destroy one of an organization's release policies by name. Releases that wait only on that policy go live without it, so confirm with the user first. Past evaluations stay on the releases they evaluated. Destroying a policy that is already gone changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the policy belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

policy.description: Required. The policy's name, as list_policies reports it.

name: destroy_policy
title: Destroy a release policy
